name: Vial placement repeatability
one_robot_action: Pick one capped vial from the source station and place it upright in a fixed rack pocket.

vial_outer_diameter.source: measured original USD world AABB width; runtime must qualify grasp envelope

pocket_inner_diameter.source: estimated top aperture from original mesh vertices; throat/collider qualification pending

observable_outcome: Vial center, upright angle and stable supported placement after release; failed grasps and drops remain failures.
success_check: After gripper clears, center error <=4 mm, tilt <=5 deg and linear speed <5 mm/s continuously for 1 s, with no drop or collision with forbidden fixtures. Report dispersion over repeated runs separately from mean target error.

science_provenance.model: Repeatability is spread under each fixed condition; target error measures accuracy.
science_provenance.limitations: Proposed geometry and tolerances, not measured SO101 performance or certified repeatability.

required_physics_beyond_meshes: SO101 articulation and calibrated gripper contacts
Vial mass/inertia and convex collision geometry
Rack pocket collision geometry with actual opening, not a solid bounding box
Contact/friction, stable release, pose/velocity logging

name: Size-based sample sorting
one_robot_action: Pick one dry sample carrier and place it in the bin designated by its observed diameter.
observable_outcome: Observed size class, chosen bin and final supported carrier location.
success_check: Correct size class AND entire carrier inside the matching bin interior, stable for 1 s after gripper clears; wrong bin, drop or abstention reported separately. Counterbalance bin positions and sample identities.

science_provenance.model: Diameter <20 mm maps to small_bin; diameter >=20 mm maps to large_bin.
science_provenance.limitations: A sorting benchmark, not chemical sample identification. Changes in diameter change contact geometry and are part of the treatment.

required_physics_beyond_meshes: Rigid carrier and open bin collision geometry
Mass/inertia, grasp/contact and release
Perception or explicit measured-size input contract; no ground-truth class supplied to a vision-only policy
Multiple named destinations and occupancy measurements

name: Density: float or sink
one_robot_action: Pick one sealed sample and gently release it at a fixed water-surface station.
observable_outcome: Model-produced surface float versus bottom rest, plus whether the robot actually released into the tank.
success_check: Manipulation: actual release inside tank without wall/gripper interference. Model check: low density equilibrium submerged fraction 0.80 +/-0.02; high density fully submerged and bottom-supported. Never count the model output as an independent validation of Archimedes physics.

science_provenance.model: F_b=rho_fluid*g*V_submerged; weight=m*g; equilibrium submerged fraction=rho_sample/rho_fluid for a floating sealed body.
science_provenance.limitations: Ideal still fluid, constant density, sealed rigid body; no CFD, waves, wetting or measured liquid. Any visual settling path is illustrative unless a validated force/drag model is added.

required_physics_beyond_meshes: Robot/sample rigid-body manipulation
Analytical submerged-volume/buoyancy model with explicit version and parameters
Tank volume trigger and release detection; remove any collision surface pretending water is solid
Separate model-generated display state from rigid-body state; do not silently teleport before a verified release

name: Ramp friction comparison
one_robot_action: Place and release one flat test block at the same marked start pose on the ramp.
observable_outcome: Ramp-axis displacement and velocity after actual gripper release, with onset of sliding and final catch-tray location.
success_check: With valid low-impulse release: low-friction block travels >=100 mm downhill within 1 s; high-friction block stays within 5 mm of release coordinate for 1 s. Record tipping/edge loss separately; check free-slide acceleration before the ramp end against 1.97 m/s^2 as a diagnostic, not an assumed trajectory.

science_provenance.kind: SIMULATED rigid-body mechanics with analytical reference
science_provenance.model: Slide onset when tan(theta)>mu_s; a=g*(sin(theta)-mu_k*cos(theta)) while sliding.
science_provenance.limitations: Coulomb approximation; solver/contact settings and friction combine mode matter. Neither a material color nor a mesh encodes friction.

required_physics_beyond_meshes: PhysX dynamic block and static ramp colliders
Explicit friction materials on BOTH contacting surfaces and verified combine mode yielding listed effective values
Mass/inertia, gravity, contact solver/time step and stable release
Contact/pose telemetry and catch tray; no scripted block trajectory

name: Lever balance and torque
one_robot_action: Pick one 10 g weight and seat it in the selected pocket of a level loading-locked beam.
observable_outcome: Beam angle and angular velocity after harness removes loading lock only once weight is seated and gripper clear.
success_check: Balanced condition stays within +/-2 deg for 1 s after unlock; left-heavy condition tilts left >=8 deg within 2 s. Verify weight remains seated and no controller drive remains enabled. Record unlock time and joint damping/friction; tune and freeze these during development.

science_provenance.kind: SIMULATED revolute-joint mechanics with analytical reference
science_provenance.model: Initial signed torque=sum(m*g*r); equal opposite moments yield zero net gravity torque at level.
science_provenance.limitations: Zero net torque alone does not restore a perturbed neutrally balanced beam to level; begin level with near-zero angular velocity. Beam must be tared and pivot friction bounded.

required_physics_beyond_meshes: Dynamic beam mass/inertia and centered COM
PhysX revolute joint on fixed fulcrum with correct axis and angle limits
Explicit low joint friction/damping and disabled drive after unlock
Weight-pocket contact that retains weights during tilt
Harness loading lock/unlock event, not a second undisclosed robot action

name: pH indicator model
one_robot_action: Pick one fresh indicator tab and dip its tip into a fixed prepared sample well, then lift it to a reading pose.
observable_outcome: Analytical indicator response appears only after valid tip-well contact; camera reads yellow versus blue with a text category.
success_check: Robot: tip intersects liquid region at 5 +/-2 mm depth for >=1 s and returns to visible reading pose. Model: base-form fraction 1/(1+10^(pKa-pH)) is about 0.0079 at pH 5 and 0.9876 at pH 9; display classifier returns expected category or unknown if occluded. Separately report classifier agreement and contact success.

science_provenance.model: Ideal single-indicator acid/base fraction using chosen pKa; qualitative endpoints inspired by bromothymol-blue response interval about pH 6.0-7.6.
science_provenance.limitations: No reaction, fluid mixing, diffusion, buffering, wetting kinetics or calibrated spectral rendering is solved. pKa 7.1 and dip timing are design parameters; this is not validated strip chemistry or a physical pH measurement.

required_physics_beyond_meshes: Rigid tab grasp/reach and contact-free well approach
Tip immersion-volume trigger with dwell timer
Versioned analytical indicator model and renderer color mapping
Separate hidden pH/model state and camera-derived color observation; fresh-tab reset
